annotation.title_clean: AI利活用に関する契約チェックリスト(AIの利用・開発契約チェックリスト)
annotation.title_en: Contract Checklist for Use and Development of AI
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 経済産業省 (Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, Japan)
annotation.summary_en: METI's checklist guides users negotiating AI usage and development contracts with vendors. It covers input and output handling, use, third-party provision, rights attribution, derived outputs, development-contract issues, Japan's Personal Information Protection Act, security and terms-of-service changes. It is voluntary and risk-allocation oriented; no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Checklist items for inputs and outputs: definition, use, external provision, rights attribution, and derived products.
Distinguishes use-type and development-type contracts (general AI service, customization, new development).
Advises minimizing unnecessary input where data may be used for AI training.
Flags Japan's APPI Articles 27-29 on third-party and cross-border transfer of personal data.
Recommends monitoring terms-of-service changes and requesting vendor logs for security.
